name: fail-closed
description: Six written standards for building agent tooling and five working skills, plus a blanket-staging guard that ships registered rather than as a template. Installing the plugin gives you eleven skills and one PreToolUse hook that refuses `git add -A`, `git add .` and `git commit -a`. A hook verifier is included because registration fails open: a guard whose script is missing never warns and never fires, so a session with a broken guard looks exactly like a session with a working one.
